title: Layout geometry explorer
description: Inventory dashboard — every layout object with individually sortable geometry columns (X, Y, width, height, Z-order). Filter by layout part (header, body, footer …), object type, maximum width/height, and a layout-absolute coordinate window (X/Y from/to) to inspect specific layout regions. Coordinates of nested objects are relative to their parent container; the coordinate window matches top-level objects exactly, nested objects count via their top-level container. The URL-only parameters w_min/h_min complement the sliders. Click a row to open the layout with the object highlighted.
author: fm-lab rules

params.name: file
params.description: Optional file filter (from the app-level filter).

params.name: part
params.description: Layout-part filter select (Header, Body, Footer …); unset = all parts.

params.name: x_min
params.description: Coordinate window, left edge (layout-absolute px); objects whose top-level container intersects the window match.

params.name: w_min
params.description: Minimum object width in px (URL-only, no slider).

params.name: w_max
params.description: Maximum object width in px (header slider).

params.name: h_min
params.description: Minimum object height in px (URL-only, no slider).

params.name: h_max
params.description: Maximum object height in px (header slider).
